role: The Lure enchantment (effect id 62, fishing-rod type): its level windows and max level in the registry the loot-book and villager-trade enchantment rolls read.
scope_reason: The enchanting table is a plain block (world.conf enchanting=off), but the enchantment registry itself is kept: loot books and mob equipment carry enchantments (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, 'Kept: enchantment data and effects').

members.name: EnchantmentFishingSpeed
members.note: setName('fishingSpeed') is the row's name field

notes: The row is part of csrc/engine/enchants.h, generated from the oracle by netherite.oracle.EnchantTable; map_enchantment_data in enchant.c walks it with the same HashMap iteration order.
